args.title: Bellwether Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026, driven by the adoption of autonomous carts (source: blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse).
- Integration of the automation systems took twice as long as planned, a key implementation caveat.
- Per the companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion), the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks rather than raw speed gains.
